name: Nico's Taco Shop
notes: Restaurant own site (nicosmexfood.com/listing/morena/) is a directory listing page with no prices or ordering platform link; used DoorDash marketplace JSON-LD (server-rendered schema.org Menu) instead, address confirmed 5151 Morena Pl matches. Markup check across all 91 raw items showed no consistent divisor (1.04-1.3 all near-zero hit rate), so prices read as DoorDash catalog prices rather than a clean surcharge, though delivery-platform pricing can still run above in-store. 8 items in a 'Most Ordered' highlight section duplicated items already listed under their real category at identical prices (cross-check within source); those duplicates were dropped and 4 unique highlight-only items kept under section Other. Sections reached: Breakfast Burritos, Combinations, Burritos, Tacos, Enchiladas, Tostadas, Tortas, Chips & Fries, Rolled Tacos, Other (drinks/sides). Uber Eats page for this restaurant returned a JS shell with no server-rendered prices (568 bytes) so no independent cross-check source was reachable without a browser.
